name: Contract Billing
office_task: When a maintenance contract's billing period closes, draft the client's service invoice in Xero at our schedule of rates, park what it cannot price, and hold it for a named person.
systems_of_record: the job system that holds each maintenance contract and closes one billing-period record per contract per cycle on its billing date (Simpro, ServiceM8 or the fire maintenance system the business runs), issuing the period's id (carried as job_id)

emits.write: One draft invoice in Xero per closed billing period, referenced job:<period id> (and the stage when the period sits under a building contract), every line a scheduled service, attendance or consumable the period carries, every rate read from the schedule of rates at draft time, and the client's signed variation attached for any asset added mid-term. A second close event updates the same draft.
emits.readback: Xero returns the InvoiceID; GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} must return the invoice with Reference job:<period id>, and that id is stamped on the period as seam.invoice_id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed and the run stops.

emits.write: The invoice leaves only after a release naming the accounts officer, or naming the rule they wrote down and showing the total is under its threshold; the release and the send time are recorded against the period. The bot never approves or emails in Xero itself.
emits.readback: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} returns it AUTHORISED and sent to the contact, and the period read by its id shows seam.released_by (a person or a rule) before the send time. A send with no release on the record is refused.

emits.write: A parked or waiting invoice as an exception on the billing period: the reason from the standard's list (not_in_pricebook, unsigned_variation, write_failed) or over_threshold, the period id, the invoice id, the codes left unpriced or unsigned, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for contract billing.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the job_id, the invoice_id, the reason and the exception_owner; the next run reads it there and stops until exception.closed.
